mapper.select: select semester_id as semesterId, semester_name as semesterName, start_date as startDate, end_date as endDate from brm_semester where status = '0' order by (start_date <= curdate() and end_date >= curdate()) desc, semester_id desc limit 1

select count(1) as totalCount, sum(student_status = '0') as enrolledCount, sum(student_status = '1') as suspendCount, sum(student_status = '2') as dropoutCount, sum(student_status = '3') as graduateCount, sum(student_status = '4') as transferOutCount, sum(student_status = '5') as keepCount from sam_student where status = '0'

select ifnull(d.dept_name, '未分配院系') as name, count(1) as value from sam_student s left join brm_department d on d.dept_id = s.dept_id where s.status = '0' and s.student_status = '0' group by name order by value desc
select ifnull(enrollment_year, '未知') as name, count(1) as value from sam_student where status = '0' and student_status = '0' group by name order by name asc
select case gender when '0' then '男' when '1' then '女' else '未知' end as name, count(1) as value from sam_student where status = '0' and student_status = '0' group by name order by value desc
select ifnull(education_level, '未填写') as name, count(1) as value from sam_student where status = '0' and student_status = '0' group by name order by value desc

select count(1) as recordCount, round(avg(total_score), 1) as avgScore, round(avg(grade_point), 2) as avgGpa, round(sum(is_pass = '1') * 100 / nullif(count(1), 0), 1) as passRate, round(sum(total_score >= 85) * 100 / nullif(count(1), 0), 1) as excellentRate from aem_grade_record where status = '0' and total_score is not null and semester_id = #{semesterId}

select band as name, count(1) as value from ( select case when total_score >= 90 then '优秀(≥90)' when total_score >= 80 then '良好(80-89)' when total_score >= 70 then '中等(70-79)' when total_score >= 60 then '及格(60-69)' else '不及格(<60)' end as band, case when total_score >= 90 then 1 when total_score >= 80 then 2 when total_score >= 70 then 3 when total_score >= 60 then 4 else 5 end as band_order from aem_grade_record where status = '0' and total_score is not null and semester_id = #{semesterId} ) t group by band, band_order order by band_order

select ifnull(d.dept_name, '未分配院系') as deptName, count(1) as recordCount, round(avg(g.total_score), 1) as avgScore, round(sum(g.is_pass = '1') * 100 / nullif(count(1), 0), 1) as passRate from aem_grade_record g join sam_student s on s.student_id = g.student_id left join brm_department d on d.dept_id = s.dept_id where g.status = '0' and g.total_score is not null and g.semester_id = #{semesterId} group by deptName order by avgScore desc

select sm.semester_name as name, round(avg(g.total_score), 1) as avgScore, round(sum(g.is_pass = '1') * 100 / nullif(count(1), 0), 1) as passRate from aem_grade_record g join brm_semester sm on sm.semester_id = g.semester_id where g.status = '0' and g.total_score is not null group by sm.semester_id, sm.semester_name order by sm.semester_id asc

select (select count(1) from brm_teacher where status = '0') as teacherCount, (select count(1) from tpm_course_offering o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.offering_status != '2' and o.semester_id = #{semesterId}) as offeringCount, (select ifnull(sum(o.class_count), 0) from tpm_course_offering o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.offering_status != '2' and o.semester_id = #{semesterId}) as classCount
select ifnull(d.dept_name, '未分配院系') as name, count(1) as value from brm_teacher t left join brm_department d on d.dept_id = t.dept_id where t.status = '0' group by name order by value desc
select ifnull(title, '未填写') as name, count(1) as value from brm_teacher where status = '0' group by name order by value desc
select ifnull(education, '未填写') as name, count(1) as value from brm_teacher where status = '0' group by name order by value desc
select case gender when '0' then '男' when '1' then '女' when '2' then '其他' else '未知' end as name, count(1) as value from brm_teacher where status = '0' group by name order by value desc

select t.teacher_name as teacherName, ifnull(d.dept_name, '未分配院系') as deptName, count(o.offering_id) as offeringCount, ifnull(sum(o.class_count), 0) as classCount, ifnull(sum(o.max_students), 0) as studentCapacity from brm_teacher t left join brm_department d on d.dept_id = t.dept_id join tpm_course_offering o on o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id and o.del_flag = '0' and o.offering_status != '2' where t.status = '0' and o.semester_id = #{semesterId} group by t.teacher_id, t.teacher_name, deptName order by offeringCount desc, classCount desc limit #{limit}

select d.dept_name as deptName, (select count(1) from sam_student s where s.dept_id = d.dept_id and s.status = '0') as totalStudent, (select count(1) from sam_student s where s.dept_id = d.dept_id and s.status = '0' and s.student_status = '0') as enrolledStudent, (select count(1) from brm_teacher t where t.dept_id = d.dept_id and t.status = '0') as teacherCount, (select count(1) from tpm_course_offering o join brm_teacher t2 on t2.teacher_id = o.teacher_id where t2.dept_id = d.dept_id and o.del_flag = '0' and o.offering_status != '2' and o.semester_id = #{semesterId}) as offeringCount, (select round(sum(g.is_pass = '1') * 100 / nullif(count(1), 0), 1) from aem_grade_record g join sam_student s2 on s2.student_id = g.student_id where s2.dept_id = d.dept_id and g.status = '0' and g.total_score is not null and g.semester_id = #{semesterId}) as avgPassRate from brm_department d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' order by d.order_num asc, d.dept_id asc
